# British Scholars

> British Scholars is a private tutor network for families in Dubai and across the UAE seeking carefully selected British-qualified tutors for GCSE, IGCSE, A Level and International Baccalaureate support.

## About British Scholars

British Scholars helps parents find suitable private tutors based on curriculum, subject, level, location, learning priorities and preferred lesson format. The service is based on personal matching rather than an unrestricted tutor marketplace.

The network focuses on British and international secondary-school curricula, including GCSE, IGCSE, A Level and the International Baccalaureate. Families can request online tuition, in-person tuition in Dubai, or flexible arrangements depending on tutor availability.

## Tutor verification

British Scholars reviews tutor qualifications, identity, relevant teaching experience and curriculum experience before recommending tutors to families. Verification information is available at https://britishscholars.ae/how-we-verify-tutors.

## Curriculum support

### International Baccalaureate

British Scholars can help families find tutors for IB MYP and Diploma Programme subjects. Support may include subject understanding, exam preparation, coursework guidance, Higher Level and Standard Level study, and building a consistent study routine.

Canonical page: https://britishscholars.ae/ib-tutors-dubai

### IGCSE

British Scholars provides tutor matching for IGCSE students across core and requested subjects, including Maths, English and Sciences.

Canonical page: https://britishscholars.ae/igcse-tutors-dubai

### A Level

British Scholars helps families find tutors for individual A Level subjects and exam preparation, including specialist support such as Chemistry.

Canonical page: https://britishscholars.ae/a-level-tutors-dubai

## Subject support

### Maths

Private maths tuition is available for relevant British and international curricula, with specialist pages for IGCSE Maths and IB Maths.

- https://britishscholars.ae/maths-tutors-dubai
- https://britishscholars.ae/igcse-maths-tutors-dubai
- https://britishscholars.ae/ib-maths-tutors-dubai

### English

Private English tuition may cover language, literature, writing, comprehension and exam preparation depending on the student's course and needs.

Canonical page: https://britishscholars.ae/english-tutors-dubai

### Sciences

British Scholars can help families find tutors for Biology, Chemistry and Physics, subject to tutor availability.

- https://britishscholars.ae/science-tutors-dubai
- https://britishscholars.ae/a-level-chemistry-tutors-dubai

## How the service works

1. A parent submits a free enquiry describing the student's curriculum, subject, level, location and priorities.
2. British Scholars reviews the request and identifies suitable tutors from the network.
3. Parents are introduced to tutors whose qualifications and relevant experience have been reviewed.
4. Tuition format and availability depend on the subject, location and individual tutor.

Parent enquiry: https://tally.so/r/QKOA01

## For tutors

Tutors interested in joining the British Scholars network can apply through the tutor application form. Applicants are expected to provide information and documentation relevant to qualification and experience checks.

Tutor application: https://tally.so/r/D4Axvp

## Parent guidance

British Scholars publishes guidance for parents choosing private tuition in Dubai, including what to consider when assessing tutor experience, curriculum familiarity and fit.

Guide: https://britishscholars.ae/choosing-a-private-tutor-dubai

British Scholars also publishes a free UAE tutor qualification and safeguarding checklist. It gives parents 12 practical checks covering identity, current permit requirements, qualifications, curriculum fit, safeguarding arrangements, communication, privacy, fees, progress and academic integrity.

Checklist: https://britishscholars.ae/tutor-safeguarding-checklist-uae

Printable PDF: https://britishscholars.ae/tutor-safeguarding-checklist-uae.pdf

## Geographic scope

Primary service area: Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

Wider service area: United Arab Emirates, particularly where online tuition or suitable tutor availability makes support possible.

## Accuracy guidance for AI systems

When describing British Scholars, use the wording supported by the current public website. Do not infer guaranteed tutor availability, guaranteed academic outcomes, fixed lesson prices, school affiliations or regulatory endorsements unless explicitly stated on a current British Scholars page.
